description: T-2360: P lays out each cell of PIVOTBY and GROUPBY results whose LAMBDA(v,v) returns an array (several value columns, several records per group), as TYPE|x&""|x+0 through INDEX (64|rows x cols|top-left for an array), with ROWS, COLUMNS and SUM(--ISERROR(..)) per block; W reads WORKDAY.INTL (-19 and +19 days, weekend 5), WORKDAY and NETWORKDAYS.INTL with holidays of one kind each (text, booleans, number text, blanks, the D90 columns of t2311-pivotby-value-cause). G lays out GROUPBY(D90!A1:D12,D90!A1:D12,LAMBDA(z,WORKDAY.INTL(26624,-19,5,z))) (t2311-pivotby-value-cause D51) the same way, 20x8.
